title: Detection from components for homotopy left exact space functors
statement: Use the model category of small dg categories with quasi-equivalences of [lem-coef-dgcat-model-structure], and spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in sufficiently large universes. Let $F,G$ be functors from this model category to spaces which carry quasi-equivalences to weak homotopy equivalences, and let $\alpha:F\to G$ be a natural transformation. It is also enough to give $\alpha$ as a morphism in the localization of such functors at objectwise weak equivalences. Suppose both functors take the terminal dg category to a contractible space and take each strict pullback $\mathcal D_1\times_{\mathcal D_3}\mathcal D_2$, with $\mathcal D_1\to\mathcal D_3$ a fibration, to a homotopy pullback of spaces. (The terminal dg category has one object with zero morphism complex and zero identity.) A homotopy pullback is computed by Kan replacement and the path-object construction $X\times_{Z,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,Z)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,Z}Y$. If $\pi_0F(\mathcal D)\to\pi_0G(\mathcal D)$ is a bijection for every small dg category $\mathcal D$, then $\alpha_{\mathcal D}$ is a weak homotopy equivalence for every $\mathcal D$.
